title: Think decorative tarp, more than a tablecloth
text:
Think decorative tarp, more than a tablecloth. This is a cute plastic tablecloth.
The background is red, with colorful winter designs all over. These make good table protectors for spills or sticky things.

The tablecloth itself has no flannel backing, so I would be cautious about the finish of any wooden table you use it on. This is basically a heavy tarp with a holiday print instead of standard blue.
